summary: Parses bit-packed dependency descriptor payloads into descriptor and structure objects.
responsibilities: Read mandatory and extended descriptor fields
Parse template dependency structures, DTIs, frame diffs, chains, and resolutions
Apply template-derived frame dependencies and frame-specific overrides

summary: Sentinel errors returned by dependency descriptor parsing when structures, template indexes, layers, or array lengths are invalid.

variables.summary: Returned when no dependency structure is available after parsing required fields.
Returned when the template dependency structure flag is set but no attached structure is produced.
Returned when parsing would exceed the maximum template count.
Returned when template layers exceed the maximum temporal layer count.
Returned when template layers exceed the maximum spatial layer count.
Returned when a descriptor references a template index not available in the current structure.
Returned when a frame dependency spatial layer has no matching resolution.
Returned when frame decode target indication count does not match structure decode targets.
Returned when frame chain diff count does not match structure chains.

summary: Reads a dependency descriptor payload into a descriptor using current or attached dependency structure state.

inner.summary: Bit-level reader over the payload bytes.
Template ID read from mandatory fields.
Whether an active decode target bitmask follows extended fields.
Whether frame-specific decode target indications are present.
Whether frame-specific frame diffs are present.
Whether frame-specific chain diffs are present.
Structure used to resolve templates and frame dependencies.

summary: Creates a DependencyDescriptorReader over a payload buffer, current structure, and output descriptor.
Parses a dependency descriptor payload and returns the number of bytes consumed.
summary_step: 1. Reads mandatory descriptor fields.
2. Reads extended fields when the payload has more than the mandatory bytes.
3. Switches current structure to an attached structure when one was parsed.
4. Invalidates the bitstream and fails when no structure is available.
5. Reads active decode target bitmask when the extended flag is present.
6. Reads frame dependency definition from the selected template and optional overrides.
7. Returns the number of bytes read from the bitstream.

summary: Reads first-packet flag, last-packet flag, template ID, and frame number from mandatory descriptor fields.
Reads extended-field presence flags and optional template dependency structure.
summary_step: 1. Reads template structure, active decode targets, custom DTI, custom frame diff, and custom chain flags.
2. Parses an attached template dependency structure when present.
3. Fails when the structure flag is present but no attached structure was produced.
4. Initializes active decode targets to all decode targets for newly attached structures.

summary: Reads an attached frame dependency structure from extended fields.
summary_step: 1. Allocates a new attached frame dependency structure on the descriptor.
2. Reads structure ID and number of decode targets.
3. Reads template layer layout, template DTIs, frame diffs, and chain data.
4. Reads a resolution-present flag and optionally reads spatial-layer resolutions.
5. Returns after parsing the attached structure.

summary: Defined integer type representing how template layer parsing advances to the next layer.
Template layer transition values used while reading and writing dependency structures.

constants.summary: Indicates another template in the same spatial and temporal layer.
Indicates the next temporal layer in the same spatial layer.
Indicates the first temporal layer of the next spatial layer.
Indicates the end of template layer entries.

summary: Reads template layer transitions into frame dependency templates.
summary_step: 1. Iteratively creates templates with the current temporal and spatial IDs.
2. Reads the two-bit next layer indicator for each template.
3. Advances temporal or spatial layer counters according to the indicator.
4. Fails when template, temporal layer, or spatial layer limits are exceeded.
5. Stops when no more layer is signaled or the bitstream becomes invalid.
6. Stores the parsed templates on the attached structure.

summary: Reads decode target indications for every template and decode target in the attached structure.
Reads template frame-diff lists until each template's follow flag ends its list.
Reads chain count, decode-target chain protection mapping, and per-template chain diffs.
summary_step: 1. Reads the non-symmetric encoded number of chains.
2. Returns when no chains are present.
3. Reads the protecting chain index for each decode target.
4. Reads four-bit chain diff values for each template and chain.

summary: Reads render resolutions for every spatial layer represented by the attached templates.
Builds frame dependency information from the selected template and optional frame-level overrides.
summary_step: 1. Resolves the template index from frame dependency template ID and structure ID.
2. Invalidates the reader and fails when the template index is out of range.
3. Clones the matching template into descriptor frame dependencies.
4. Applies custom DTIs, frame diffs, and chain diffs when their flags are present.
5. Clears resolution when the structure has no resolutions.
6. Validates the spatial layer and assigns the matching render resolution.

summary: Reads frame-specific decode target indications after validating the expected count.
Reads frame-specific frame diffs using variable-sized diff entries until a zero size terminator is reached.
Reads frame-specific chain diffs after validating the expected chain count.
